title: Homebuying Milestone Monthly Rollup
dataSources: Mortgage-rate snapshots (`mortgage:rate`), property-listing and Zestimate data (`property:listing`), HOA fees (`hoa:fee`), property-tax installments (`propertytax:installment`), home-buying milestones (`homebuying:milestone`).
app: Mortgage-rate watchers, Zestimate exports, HOA-fee logs, and property-tax installment trackers streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, CSV exports, and personal checklists.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=homebuying:milestone
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats count as events, sum(value) as total_value by _time
| sort _time
description: Summarises monthly event volume and total value for homebuying milestone data.
value: Monthly rollups smooth daily noise and show seasonal shifts in personal activity.
implementation: Aggregate homebuying milestone events monthly and chart count plus total value.
visualization: Column chart of monthly events with total value overlay.
grandmaExplanation: It tells you how your homebuying milestone activity added up each month instead of day by day.
